liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Morning Dew** (3 reviews): The jam before the final verse gets very hot, then drops to a whisper-quiet passage with a single light on Jerry; Dew is nice, but reviewer says its vocals are flubbed before the solo [13][22][23]
- **Jack Straw** (2 reviews): Strong opening Jack Straw, followed by a long break before a warmly received Bertha; Band energy is wild from the start, audible in the Jack Straw into Bertha opening [19][20]
- **All Along The Watchtower** (2 reviews): Jerry plays a shredding solo, then settles down to find the right D note that opens Morning Dew; After Space, a fiery Watchtower with Jerry shredding; reviewer's favorite version, fading out before Morning Dew [13][20]
- **Space** (1 review): Some of Phil's notes during Space physically shook the reviewer's body [15]

## Setlist highlights

- **encore call**: back after 198 archived shows (965 days); rare: 13 archived performances [24]

## The recordings

- **gd1991-03-23.aud.koucky-greenberg.gmb.81869.sbeok.flac16** (recommended): audience recording; 20 songs; 155 min [1]
- **gd91-03-23.schoeps.oconnor.9507.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 18 songs; 166 min; rated 2.71/5 by 7 [4]. Said about its sound: Reviewer finds the audience recording's sound quality very poor and asks whether a soundboard exists [12]
- **gd1991-03-23.nak300.andrewf.34967.sbeok.flac16**: source not stated; 18 songs; 161 min; rated 2.5/5 by 2 [6]
- **gd1991-03-23.149299.FOB.Schoeps.unknown.Ammons.Noel.t-flac1648**: source not stated; 18 songs; 163 min [8]. Said about its sound: Minor microphone bumps and audience chatter were addressed in editing [8]

## Around the show

- Reviewer attended as a 16-year-old with a front-row center seat [15]
- Reviewer's sister had tickets for the following night, seated beside Rick Danko and Mountain Girl [15]
- Reviewer stood in the last row of the floor and was puzzled that chairs were set out there [16]
- For many fans these were the first shows seen since Brent's death, which weighed on many minds [19]
- Vince played solo on keyboards for all three Albany shows [19]
- A McDonald's near the venue was packed with heads and tie-dye before the show [21]
- A child asked if the circus was in town; a fan replied that they were the circus [21]
- A crowded public transit ride from Schenectady carried fans, and the scene around the arena spread through the surrounding city [21]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1991-03-23.aud.koucky-greenberg.gmb.81869.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Bill Koucky; transferred by Chris Ladner; source: FOB Nak 700s > Sony D5 > Type IV cassette (Maxell MX100s), no Dolby during recording. [1]
- **gd91-03-23.schoeps.oconnor.9507.sbeok.shnf**: source: AUD: Schoeps CMC 34Âs>DAT [4]. Also: Audience recording made with Schoeps CMC 34 microphones to DAT, passed along via Paul and seeded to etree by eD(efojr) [4]
- **gd1991-03-23.nak300.andrewf.34967.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Andrew F; transferred by Andrew F; source: Nackamichi CM-300's with CP-4 shotgun capsules > Casio DA-7 Dat. Taped onto Maxell DM-120 tape, set up in second row of taper's section, center seat. Mics on… [6]. Also: The second-set DAT was burned to two discs overlapping in Drums; Soundforge rejoined the files without duplicate material; Soundforge was used to add fades at the start and end of sets [6]
- **gd1991-03-23.149299.FOB.Schoeps.unknown.Ammons.Noel.t-flac1648**: taped by Unknown; transferred by John Ammons and Joe Noel; source: Recording info: (FOB) Schoeps CMC34 @ 110˚ > M1000 Cables > Tao Research PS > Panasonic SV255 > Master DAT > clone [8]. Also: Master digital recording from the front-of-board position, cloned and transferred by John Ammons, then mastered by Joe Noel in Adobe Audition; Taper is uncertain, but the notes point to Dan O'Neil recording while running Bob Melomed's rig [8]
